title: Fill the sentence-boundary rule
concept: A chunker that splits on '.' alone splits 'v2.1.4' and 'Dr. Smith'. The rule is a boundary, not a character.
skill: You can state what a sentence boundary IS -- a terminator followed by whitespace and an uppercase start -- rather than a character to split on.
deeper: docs/60-cheatsheets/frameworks/precondition-test.md -- because a chunker is the first thing people 'improve' without checking their corpus has the failure
